import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Clear old pm2 logs and restart to get fresh logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /root/opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 3")
print("Restarted PM2")
print(stdout.read().decode())
print(stderr.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list")
print("\\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 20 --nostream")
print("\\n=== Logs ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
'
